description: Gironde : coproduction réseaux des pistes cyclables dans le cadre de l'atelier PIGMA - Infrastructures Cyclables Existantes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pigma.org. Result layer of the network of bike paths in Gironde as part of the PIGMA bike paths workshop. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Gironde: co-production of bicycle path networks in the framework of the PIGMA workshop - Existing Cycling Infrastructure" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vélo, Gironde, SIG, Infrastructures, gip_atgeri, Tourisme. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
